assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded as CPT 93229.
The related diagnosis codes are I25.10, I34.0, and R42.
The required precertification was not obtained before services were rendered.
The claim was denied under Reason Code CO-197.
This appeal requests reconsideration of the medical necessity determination.
